editorial.blurb: Jieyi Sushi brings together pristine sushi and an impressive roster of Japanese, Thai, and Chinese dishes—all especially generous when ordered all-you-can-eat.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the AYCE option on a weekday early evening when it's quieter; they'll give you a simple sheet to mark what you want, and at $35+ for a sushi boat elsewhere, you'll easily get your money's worth. Their delivery is reliable for late-night cravings too.
